source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Whenever this unit gets **selected to fight** in [either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), you can take a [Leadership roll](vsdata:core-rule/leadership-rolls) for it. If you do, it can re-roll 1s to [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) on its melee attacks, and if the roll succeeds, it can also re-roll 1s to [Wound](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) on them.

combat.unresolved: An Or: bullet that changes what an effect gives is read as a numbered option with no effect.
